title: New Awesomic: Prompt with AI, perfect with experts — all in one app
summary: Prompt with AI, perfect with experts. Your team, AI agents and vetted designers work in one app, and every project runs on its own cloud computer.
body_markdown:
Today we're launching Awesomic Supernova, the new Awesomic and our biggest release yet. Prompt with AI, perfect with experts, all in one app. Your AI agents, your team and vetted experts work on the same projects, in the same chats, with the same memory of your brand, on desktop and on your phone.


Most teams we talk to now have a dozen AI tabs open, a few subscriptions nobody tracks, and a freelancer somewhere on Slack. None of it is connected. Supernova is our answer: close the tabs and make it together.


Here's why we built it and what you can do with it today.


## Five years ago, the problem was finding people


When we started Awesomic in 2021, hiring creative help was a gamble. You could spend weeks looking for the right person and still have no idea what quality you'd get. Sometimes the designer just disappeared halfway through.


So we built a better way to work with people: rigorous vetting, fast matching, and real ownership of delivery. Since then, more than 4,000 companies, including 500+ from YC, have finished over 30,000 tasks with our vetted experts.


Then the problem changed.


## Now the problem is too much AI, and none of it connected


Every team we talk to is running AI somewhere, and agents now do most of the work. But the last 20% (taste, brand, judgment) is the new 80%. On their own, agents drift off brand, and someone still has to point them in the right direction and check the result. Meanwhile the work is scattered across tools that don't share anything: not files, not context, not decisions. Laptops can't run agents for long, and hiring a person still takes weeks before any real work starts.


We don't think the answer is AI *or* people. Agents are now one more kind of intelligence on the team. Humans give them direction and check their work; agents turn that direction into scale. That only works if both live in the same place.


## What Supernova is


Supernova isn't a chatbot, and it isn't a design service with AI bolted on. It's a full-stack AI workplace for humans and agents: prompt with AI, then perfect the result with experts, in the same project.


### Every project is a cloud computer


It looks like a chat, but behind every project is an ultra-fast cloud computer that boots in 7 seconds, with 32 GB of RAM and 1 TB of storage. Agents install, run and publish real programs there, so a project can be a website, an internal CRM, a dev environment or an always-on agent, not just a chat. It handles a two-minute request as well as an agent that runs for hours, and the work keeps going after you close your laptop.


### Any agent, any model


Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more, with the top models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and xAI in one place. Pick the best one for each task and switch any time, with no lock-in and one bill across every AI. Already have a Claude or Codex plan? You can bring it, but you don't have to.


### Several agents at once


Give one agent the landing page, another the launch video, a third the ads. Each works in its own chat, in parallel, on the same project files.


### Your tools, connected


More than 1,000 apps, including Slack, Notion, Gmail, Google Drive, Figma, GitHub, HubSpot, Shopify and Stripe. Connect once and every chat can use them. Keys and logins go in a shared team keychain: add a key once, and every teammate's agents can use it without anyone seeing the value. Agents can even work directly in your Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok ad accounts to set up campaigns and retargeting.


### One workspace, one memory


Your whole team works in one place. Share a project with a link, and everyone talks to the same agents in the same chat. Supernova remembers your brand, your files and your decisions, so every agent and every person starts from the same context. A new teammate installs nothing; they open the project and pick up where you left off.


### Vetted experts, plugged into your workflow


When something needs a pro's eye, hand the task to an Awesomic expert right from the chat. Design is where Awesomic started, and designers are still the core of our network, alongside developers and marketers. Our experts are the top 1% of everyone who applies, matched within 24 hours, with free rematches. They join your project, see the files, the brand and everything your agents did, and take the task all the way to done. No brief, no onboarding. Bring one in for a single task, hire long-term, or make them the person in the loop who reviews what your agents produce.


### Admins set the rules


See every prompt and result your team creates, and turn what works into shared skills. Set access, approved models and budgets per person, see spend per person and per model, and plug in your own MCP servers. And because Awesomic is going open source, your company's memory can stay fully private on your own infrastructure.


### Make anything, from anywhere


Landing pages, decks, emails, apps, ads, videos and brand kits. Publish a site to a live link in one click. Start from great work on Explore and remix it, add skills that teach your agents new tricks, or schedule recurring work like weekly social posts. It all runs in your browser and in the[mobile app for iOS and Android](https://studio.awesomic.com/download) , which isn't just a viewer: start a task, watch the agent work, open the live result and hand it to an expert from your phone.


Agents bring the scale. Humans bring the direction and the taste. Supernova is where they work as one team.


## What that looks like in practice


We tried it on ourselves first. Over the past year we moved the whole company onto agents, before we had anything to sell. Designers on our team retrained as design engineers. People who had never written code shipped hundreds of pull requests to our own product.


This launch was made in Supernova too: the film, the site and this post. We made the first versions of the landing page and the video with agents. When the video needed a pro's eye, we handed it to one of our designers from the same project. They opened the same files and chat history and finished it the same day, with no brief and no files sent. Pages that used to take weeks now go live in hours.


That's the shift. An illustrator can ship a landing page. A marketer can make a video without waiting on a motion designer. An SEO specialist can build an ROI calculator on their own. And when the work needs an expert, the expert joins the same project instead of a separate thread.


## Pricing


You can use Supernova three ways:


- **Agents.** Plans start at $19 per user per month. Full access to agents, models, the cloud computer and apps. Best for founders and small teams who want to move fast.
- **Experts.** Work with a vetted Awesomic expert, as before: matched within 24 hours, a dedicated account manager, and a free rematch whenever it's not the right fit. Your expert works inside Supernova, so you can see everything in one place.
- **Both.** Our recommended setup for teams that ship a lot: agents take the volume, experts own the quality.
